cvars.name: crowdy.entity.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication entity activity: registry add/remove, event routing and dispatch, entity components, and actor tracking/management. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.exec.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs Server Object activity: status changes, applied reads and pushes with their epoch and seq, re-reads, subscribes, calls and the connection. Never values or tokens. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.hud.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyServices HUD activity: HUD base and widgets. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.anim.dump
cvars.help: While set to 1, log a summary of the animation sets in use and of the instance batches handed to each instanced skinned mesh component, once per second. Set back to 0 to stop.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.anim.force
cvars.help: Force this animation bank sequence index on every Mass entity the Crowdy animation processor sees. A negative value disables forcing, which is the default.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.anim.releasefromobserver
cvars.help: Release an entity's renderer visual straight from the destruction observer instead of deferring it to the next frame. This is the behaviour the deferral replaced and it leaks an animation track per entity destroyed mid-frame. It exists so the animation track gate can be proven to fail. 0 is correct behaviour and the default.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.anim.trace
cvars.help: Log every animation sequence index the Crowdy animation processor writes, per entity.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.profile
cvars.help: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.profile

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.start
cvars.help: Crowd simulation: emit position updates for N simulated players through the real send path. Args: [count] [radiusMetres] [class].crowdy.mass.crowdsim.start

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.status
cvars.help: Crowd simulation: report the rate actually achieved, what the simulated players are doing, and how they are spread over chunks.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.stop
cvars.help: Crowd simulation: stop emitting. The simulated players are left to the tracker's normal timeout.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.derive
cvars.help: Says what a Mass entity config derived from an actor class would contain, without spawning anything. Args: <class>, a short name, an asset path or a full object path.Usage: crowdy.mass.derive <class>, a short name, an asset path or a full object path.crowdy.mass.derive: %scrowdy.mass.derive: %scrowdy.mass.derive: %s

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.derive.force
cvars.help: Spawn every remote entity from a Mass entity config built out of its own class, pushing aside the per-class binding, the backend override and the project-wide Remote Entity Config. 1 on, 0 off. The class's animation set is pushed aside with it, so the entity animates from the set and the Bank the class itself declares, and an entity that appears in bind pose under this is showing what an unconfigured class carries. Entities already spawned keep the config they were built from; every class's animation answer is worked out again.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.event.proxy
cvars.help: Run an inbound event's own body on a per-class stand-in for entities held here as rows. 1 on, 0 off. Off, an event nothing registered a handler for lands nothing beyond the action write a declared action gets, which is what this client did before the stand-in existed.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.gates
cvars.help: Runs every automated gate and prints one PASS/FAIL report to copy in a single selection: the one-shot action path, the view-state echo (a pose landing, a second echo changing it, a pose touching nothing else, a pose clearing, a hostile echo in every field being unable to unmake an entity, a truncated payload, a forged payload), the renderer's animation track count across a spawn and destroy churn, whether every authored pose resolves to a bank slot of its own, the CrowdyState delta path into an entity that owns no participant (which road actually wrote the pose, what was dropped, and whether a field registered from outside this module receives its bytes), and any gate a game has registered. Optional arg: how many entities the churn spawns (default 64, clamped 1 to 1024). Around fifteen seconds at the default; forces crowdy.rpc.loopback on for the run and restores it afterwards.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.gates.stop
cvars.help: Abandons a gate run in progress, destroying its entities and restoring crowdy.rpc.loopback.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.interp.adaptive
cvars.help: Replay each remote segment over the observed arrival interval. 1 on, 0 off (fixed duration), -1 to follow the project setting.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.interp.max
cvars.help: Longest span a remote segment may be replayed over, in seconds. Negative to follow the project setting.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.interp.min
cvars.help: Shortest span a remote segment may be replayed over, in seconds. Negative to follow the project setting.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.interp.overshoot
cvars.help: How much longer than the observed arrival interval a remote segment is replayed over. Negative to follow the project setting.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.neartier.trace
cvars.help: Say when a crowd entity gains a near tier actor, whether that actor was built or taken from the pool, and when it goes back. 1 on, 0 off.

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.nodes.trace
cvars.help: Log where the Call Crowdy Event on Entity dropdown's entries came from (0 = off, 1 = on).

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.oneshot
cvars.help: Fires one PlayOneShot at a Mass entity along the camera's aim, or at any tracked one. Args: <actionId> [variant] [playRate].

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.proxyprobe
cvars.help: Builds a never-spawned dispatch proxy of a class and reports what is real on it: which components exist, which are registered, whether a body would be allowed to run, and what only a genuinely spawned actor has. Args: <ClassPathOrName> [FunctionName] [SpawnComparison 0|1, default 1]. The comparison spawns and immediately destroys one real actor of the class, which runs its construction script and its BeginPlay.[dispatch proxy probe]: name a class, for example crowdy.mass.proxyprobe /Game/Characters/BP_Hero.BP_Hero_C[dispatch proxy probe]: nothing loaded for '%s'. A Blueprint class path ends in _C.0%s

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.sendaction
cvars.help: Sends the SDK's generic Crowdy action at a Mass entity along the camera's aim, or at any tracked one, through the real Send Crowdy Action path: it reaches every machine drawing the entity, this one included, and unlike crowdy.mass.oneshot it carries no ownership check. Args: <actionName> [variant] [playRate].

cvars.name: crowdy.mass.state.verdict
cvars.help: Print one block describing whether CrowdyState is reaching crowd entities: every replicated property no fragment field claims, deltas claimed and applied, every drop reason, and which road wrote the pose. Paste the whole block when reporting a gate.[CrowdyState verdict] no Crowdy Mass subsystem for this world, so run this from a play session.

cvars.name: crowdy.net.http2
cvars.help: Asks for HTTP/2 on the SDK's own requests, falling back to HTTP/1.1 when the server does not offer it; 0 leaves the engine's HTTP version. With HTTP/2 the curl diagnostics the engine logs for a failed request can include the request headers, bearer token included, so set 0 if you ship logs from builds with logging enabled.

cvars.name: crowdy.net.receive.poolactorupdates
cvars.help: Reuse actor update message objects instead of allocating one per received message (default 1). Turn it off to measure what the pool is worth on the same build.

cvars.name: crowdy.net.retry.busy
cvars.help: Sends an SDK query again, up to 3 times with backoff, when the platform refuses it and says to retry (blame PLATFORM, retryable). 0 hands every refusal straight to the caller.

cvars.name: crowdy.net.routes
cvars.help: Prints the network router's subscription table: every payload key and opcode, with the struct behind it where one is registered, and every subscriber by role.

cvars.name: crowdy.net.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet UDP transport activity: socket open/close, message sends and receives, worker-thread pool, and buffer pool churn. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.pool.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication actor-pool activity: spawn, release, reuse, and rendering-backend churn. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.query.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet GraphQL activity: query dispatch and responses. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.rpc.allowObjectLoad
cvars.help: When non-zero, a received object or class reference whose asset is not already resident is loaded from disk by path. Default 0 (find-only) so an untrusted peer cannot trigger arbitrary asset loads; an unresolved reference is delivered as null.

cvars.name: crowdy.rpc.dumpfn
cvars.help: Reports what a Crowdy event is in this process: resolved, replicated, its recipient, its FunctionID, and whether its compiled body carries the dispatch gate. Args: <ClassPathOrName> <FunctionName>. A Blueprint class name ends in _C.[CrowdyRPC] dumpfn: name a class and a function, for example crowdy.rpc.dumpfn BP_Hero_C MyEvent[CrowdyRPC] dumpfn: nothing loaded for '%s'. A Blueprint class name ends in _C._Implementation[CrowdyRPC] dumpfn: '%s' declares no function '%s' (nor its _Implementation).[CrowdyRPC] dumpfn %s::%s declaredOn=%s replicates=%d blueprintEvent=%d gate=%s recipient=%s action=%d functionID=%lldYESMISSINGn/a, native?[CrowdyRPC] dumpfn: this event is NOT an action in this process, so it starts no animation on a crowd entity. A Blueprint event carries that through its Is A One-Shot Action marker; if it is ticked in the editor and reads 0 here, this process did not get the marker.[CrowdyRPC] dumpfn: this event sends NOTHING in this process. Its body runs locally and no send code is entered, so nothing else reports it.

cvars.name: crowdy.rpc.loopback
cvars.help: When non-zero, a sent replicated CrowdyEvent is also delivered to this client's own receive path, so the whole serialize/resolve/dispatch round-trip can be tested without a second client. The call runs once locally through that path; a call made from the replayed body is sent normally but does not loop back, so there is no cascade.

cvars.name: crowdy.rpc.reliable.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs just the reliable (channel-transport) RPC path: a Multicast CrowdyEvent's channel send and the matching receive on every member. Narrower than crowdy.rpc.trace, which covers all RPC sends and receives; either one surfaces the reliable lines.

cvars.name: crowdy.rpc.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs every CrowdyEvent RPC send and receive: function, entity, addressing, owned/delegated classification, and parameter byte size.

cvars.name: crowdy.sdk.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs top-level CrowdySDK activity: subsystem lifecycle and configuration / gameplay-tag path registration. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.serialize.scopes
cvars.help: When non-zero, emits the fine-grained CPU trace scopes inside payload decode. Each one costs two timestamps per received message and is nested inside a scope that is itself measured, so it is off by default and a reading must say whether the run carried it.

cvars.name: crowdy.serialize.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet payload serialization: message encode/decode and payload/class registry resolves. High frequency, so off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.services.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyServices activity: authentication, teams, avatars, persistence, host subsystem, utilities, and Blueprint reception. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.state.heartbeat.advisories
cvars.help: Lists every CrowdyState enum property this process found outside the keyframe heartbeat, and how many resolutions each one's single warning stands for.%s

cvars.name: crowdy.state.loopback
cvars.help: When non-zero, a sent CrowdyState delta for an owned entity is also decoded onto a local 'mirror' entity (a lazily-spawned second instance of the same class, RemoteProxy role, a distinct NetID) so decode/OnRep/host-authority checks can be exercised from one PIE client. Unlike crowdy.rpc.loopback this cannot replay onto the same actor (an owner's own entity silently drops a non-host-sourced delta, and decode's changed-detection would report no change against identical values); the mirror is a genuinely distinct receive target instead.

cvars.name: crowdy.state.scopes
cvars.help: When non-zero, emits a CPU trace scope around each CrowdyState delta decode. Nested inside the enclosing delivery scope, so it shifts that scope's own figure: turn it on only for a run that needs the split. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.state.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication CrowdyState replicator activity: owned-entity diffing, delta emission, and datagram sizes. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.studio.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs each CrowdyStudio console GraphQL op: its plane, operation name, and outcome (HTTP code, error count). The bearer token is never logged. Off by default.

cvars.name: crowdy.voice.trace
cvars.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyVoice activity: voice chat subsystem, capture/playback service, and audio device monitoring. Off by default.
